description: One-glance health of EventLink streams from directory-exporter, eventlink-trace-exporter and eventlink-db-exporter 1.6+: Node Manager and node status, live delay, last collected / distributed, collected → distributed delay, backlog, stuck queues, discards and rejects.

panels.description: UP = Prometheus can scrape directory-exporter AND its first scan has completed.
panels.title: Exporter

panels.description: Seconds since the exporter last finished a scan cycle. Scan interval is 120s, so above 240s means data is stale.
panels.title: Data age

panels.description: Nodes whose heartbeat deadline (control/1/heartbeat) has not passed.
panels.title: Running nodes

panels.description: Nodes that are down now but were running at some point in the last 24h. Nodes switched off for longer are not counted.
panels.title: Stopped (24h)

panels.description: Nodes with an 'aborted and was disabled' or 'Node index … failed' trace line in the last 24h.
panels.title: Failed (24h)

panels.description: Collected → distributed delay, 95th percentile over the last hour: distribution time minus the collection time in the file ID. Green < 5 min, orange < 30 min.
panels.title: Delay p95 (1h)

panels.description: Files waiting in all node input queues. Output side is excluded to avoid double counting (a queue is one node's output and the next node's input).
panels.title: Total backlog

panels.description: Input queues whose oldest waiting file is older than 'Stuck after'.
panels.title: Stuck queues

panels.description: Running collectors whose last collected file (audit_info) is older than 10 min. Not a processing delay — see 'Delay p95'.
panels.title: Collectors idle

panels.description: Running distributors whose last distributed file (trace log or TargetDirectory change) is older than 10 min.
panels.title: Distributors idle

panels.description: New files in discarded/ (and its subfolders) in the last 24h.
panels.title: Discarded · 24h

panels.description: New files in rejected/ (and its subfolders) in the last 24h. File count, not CDR record count.
panels.title: Rejected · 24h

panels.description: Streams whose live delay is above “Delay threshold”. Live delay = age of the oldest file still waiting in any input queue of the stream (collection time from the EventLink file ID in its name; queues without IDs use file modification time). Only nodes running now or in the last 24h count.

targets.expr: count(max by (stream) (max by (stream,node) (label_replace((time() - directory_queue_oldest_collected_timestamp_seconds{eventlink=~"$eventlink",stream=~"$stream",type=~"[^/]+/input/.+"}) or (time() - (directory_oldest_file_timestamp_seconds{eventlink=~"$eventlink",stream=~"$stream",type=~"[^/]+/input/.+"} and on(base,stream,type) directory_file_count{eventlink=~"$eventlink",stream=~"$stream",type=~"[^/]+/input/.+"} > 0)), "node", "$1", "type", "([^/]+)/.*")) and on(stream,node) (max_over_time(directory_node_up{eventlink=~"$eventlink",stream=~"$stream"}[24h]) == 1)) > $delay) or vector(0)

panels.title: Streams delayed

panels.description: Nodes whose oldest waiting input file is older than “Delay threshold” (running now or in the last 24h).

targets.expr: count(max by (stream,node) (label_replace((time() - directory_queue_oldest_collected_timestamp_seconds{eventlink=~"$eventlink",stream=~"$stream",type=~"[^/]+/input/.+"}) or (time() - (directory_oldest_file_timestamp_seconds{eventlink=~"$eventlink",stream=~"$stream",type=~"[^/]+/input/.+"} and on(base,stream,type) directory_file_count{eventlink=~"$eventlink",stream=~"$stream",type=~"[^/]+/input/.+"} > 0)), "node", "$1", "type", "([^/]+)/.*")) and on(stream,node) (max_over_time(directory_node_up{eventlink=~"$eventlink",stream=~"$stream"}[24h]) == 1) > $delay) or vector(0)

panels.title: Nodes delayed

panels.description: Largest live delay over nodes running now or in the last 24h. 0 = nothing is waiting.

targets.expr: max(max by (stream,node) (label_replace((time() - directory_queue_oldest_collected_timestamp_seconds{eventlink=~"$eventlink",stream=~"$stream",type=~"[^/]+/input/.+"}) or (time() - (directory_oldest_file_timestamp_seconds{eventlink=~"$eventlink",stream=~"$stream",type=~"[^/]+/input/.+"} and on(base,stream,type) directory_file_count{eventlink=~"$eventlink",stream=~"$stream",type=~"[^/]+/input/.+"} > 0)), "node", "$1", "type", "([^/]+)/.*")) and on(stream,node) (max_over_time(directory_node_up{eventlink=~"$eventlink",stream=~"$stream"}[24h]) == 1)) or vector(0)

panels.title: Max live delay

panels.description: Streams whose collected → distributed delay p95 over the last hour (trace logs, matched by file name before the first “.”) is above “Delay threshold”.

targets.expr: count(histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (stream, le) (rate(eventlink_name_latency_seconds_bucket{eventlink=~"$eventlink",stream=~"$stream"}[1h]))) > $delay) or vector(0)

panels.title: Streams slow (p95 1h)

panels.description: Share of distributed files whose collection was found by file name (part before the first “.”); the rest use the collection time in the file ID. Low values: names change completely between input and output, or the exporter restarted recently.
panels.title: Matched by name (1h)

panels.description: UP = Prometheus can scrape eventlink-trace-exporter (:9202) AND its first trace poll has finished.
panels.title: Trace exporter

panels.description: Live delay = age of the oldest file waiting in the stream's input queues (buffer folders, nodes running now or in the last 24h); Delayed = live delay above “Delay threshold”. Waiting at stopped nodes = the same for nodes off for more than 24h. Last file / p95 = collected → distributed from trace logs, matched by file name before the first “.” (ID-based p95 for comparison). Pending (trace) = collected with no distribution logged yet; it includes files EventLink filtered or discarded without logging, so it is a hint only. Last trace line: when it grows while files still flow, EventLink stopped writing the stream's trace (e.g. the Node Manager stopped, see “Trace logging”) and trace values are frozen.

max by (stream) (max by (stream,node) (label_replace((time() - directory_queue_oldest_collected_timestamp_seconds{eventlink=~"$eventlink",stream=~"$stream",type=~"[^/]+/input/.+"}) or (time() - (directory_oldest_file_timestamp_seconds{eventlink=~"$eventlink",stream=~"$stream",type=~"[^/]+/input/.+"} and on(base,stream,type) directory_file_count{eventlink=~"$eventlink",stream=~"$stream",type=~"[^/]+/input/.+"} > 0)), "node", "$1", "type", "([^/]+)/.*")) unless on(stream,node) (max_over_time(directory_node_up{eventlink=~"$eventlink",stream=~"$stream"}[24h]) == 1))

Name match = share of this node's distributions matched by name in the last hour.

panels.title: Collected → distributed p95 by stream (by name)

panels.description: Time since the newest line in any EventLink trace log. The EventLink Node Manager writes a line every minute (Java VM memory info), so red = the Node Manager stopped: trace-based values (counters, delay, last times) are frozen while the nodes may still run.
panels.title: Trace logging

panels.description: Streams with a collected file in the last hour (collector audit_info or trace log).

targets.expr: count((max by (stream) (max by (stream,node) ({eventlink=~"$eventlink",__name__=~"directory_collector_last_activity_timestamp_seconds|eventlink_node_last_collected_timestamp_seconds",stream=~"$stream"}) unless on(stream,node) directory_node_info{eventlink=~"$eventlink",stream=~"$stream",node_type!~".*collector.*",node_type!=""})) > time() - 3600) or vector(0)

panels.title: Streams collected · 1h

panels.description: Streams with a distributed file in the last hour (trace log or distributor TargetDirectory).

panels.description: Streams with running nodes but no known distribution in the last 24h (or never seen in the last 7 days of trace logs).

panels.title: Running, nothing distributed · 24h

panels.description: Last collected = newest collection by a collector of the stream: storage/1/audit_info of FTP collectors, or the newest “Collected file” trace line. Last distributed = newest distribution by a distributor: “Distributed file” trace line or the distributor's TargetDirectory change time. Trace logs are read for the last 7 days; streams whose trace never logs file events (most streams on 102) show “-” unless they have audit_info / TargetDirectory. Since: orange after 1h, red after 24h.

panels.title: $investigate: health

panels.description: Every node, worst first. Status: Failed (24h) > Stopped (heartbeat deadline passed) > Not consuming (input older than “Stuck after”) > Idle (collector/distributor last file older than 10 min) > OK. Delay = collected → distributed of the node's last distributed file.

panels.title: $investigate: nodes

panels.description: Queues of this stream that hold files: producer node → queue → consumer node.
panels.title: $investigate: where data is piling up

panels.description: Files waiting in each node's input queues. A rising line = that node is not keeping up.
panels.title: $investigate: backlog per node

panels.description: Files collected vs distributed per minute (trace logs). The gap between the lines is what accumulates in the stream.
panels.title: $investigate: files per minute

panels.description: p50 and p95 of distribution time minus collection time (file ID), over 15 min windows.
panels.title: $investigate: collected → distributed delay

panels.description: Input queues holding files older than the 'Stuck after' threshold, worst first. Oldest waiting = how long data has been sitting; Last arrival = when the newest file landed.
panels.title: Stuck queues

panels.description: From storage/1/audit_info (now - epoch). Green < 10m, orange < 1h, red >= 1h. Mirrors monitoring.sh 'Collectors Delay' + 'Last Collected File'.
panels.title: Last file collected

panels.description: Newest of: last Distributed file trace line, and the last change of the local TargetDirectory (keeps working when EventLink stops logging). Time since the last distributed file, not processing delay.
panels.title: Last file distributed

panels.description: Files sitting in a collector's SourceDirectory, not yet collected. Files here plus a delayed collector = collector stuck; empty here plus a delayed collector = the source sent nothing.
panels.title: Waiting at source (collector SourceDirectory)

panels.description: Files in each node's discarded/<folder> and rejected/<reason> folders, with new files in the last 24h. File counts, not CDR record counts.
panels.title: Discards & rejects

panels.description: 95th percentile of distribution time minus collection time (file ID), per stream, 15 min windows. Only streams that distributed files in the window appear.
panels.title: Collected → distributed delay p95 by stream

panels.description: All selected streams, from trace logs. A widening gap = files accumulating inside the streams.
panels.title: Files per minute: collected vs distributed

panels.description: Replaces the monitoring.sh 'Statistic' table: files collected/distributed and records read/written per stream in the last 24h (trace logs), delay p95, and how long ago the stream last wrote a trace line (a growing value while files still flow = EventLink stopped logging).
panels.title: Statistic per stream (24h)

options.content:
### How to read it
- **Top tiles**: green = OK, orange = look at it, red = act. Hover a title for what it measures.
- **Top 3 streams** ranks streams by issues; click a stream to focus the whole dashboard on it.
- **Stuck after** (top bar) sets when a waiting file counts as stuck.

### Words used
| Term | Meaning |
|---|---|
| **Delay** | Collected → distributed time of a file: distribution time minus the collection time in its EventLink file ID; “by name” matches the collection by the file name before the first “.” (file_x.el.gz = file_x.el.encoded) |
| **Live delay** | Age of the oldest file still waiting in a node's input queues (buffer folders): collection time from the EventLink file ID in its name, or file modification time when names carry no ID. Keeps rising while files do not move |
| **Delayed** | Live delay above “Delay threshold” (top bar), counted for nodes running now or in the last 24h |
| **Last collected / distributed** | Newest collection by a collector (audit_info or trace log) and newest distribution by a distributor (trace log or TargetDirectory) of the stream |
| **Idle** | Time since a collector/distributor last handled a file (no traffic ≠ problem) |
| **Stopped** | Heartbeat deadline in `control/1/heartbeat` has passed |
| **Not consuming** | Node's input has files older than “Stuck after” |

### Source
Prometheus job `eventlink-db-exporter` → `<eventlink-server>:9203`: EventLink database (read-only): Node Manager, node status, events, reporting (1.6.0+).
Prometheus job `eventlink-trace-exporter` → `<eventlink-server>:9202`: trace log counters and collected → distributed delay (1.4.0+).
Prometheus job `directory-exporter` → `<eventlink-server>:9200` (exporter ≥ 1.2.0). Folder counts every 120 s; trace logs are read incrementally (counters start when the exporter starts).

### Caveats
- A queue is one node's **output** and the next node's **input**; backlog uses input only.
- Oldest/newest file times come from at most 5000 files per folder; *oldest collected* uses file names and covers all files.
- Files that arrive and are consumed between two scans are not seen in folder counts (they are in trace-log counters).
- Rejected = file count, not CDR record count.
